# Compact questionnaire · 0.31.4

Applied one compact question header across the profile and profession follow-ups. Removed section eyebrows, repeated reassurance, redundant category headings on lifestyle questions, and duplicate Next/unsure actions. The first lifestyle and official interest screens retain their brief orientation. Multi-select screens retain the necessary instruction: choose any that fit, or choose up to three.

All answer lists remain one column. Choice text remains 18px, headings use 24–30px, and choice buttons have a 48px minimum height with space to wrap. Official O*NET item wording, answer labels, order, scoring, saved results and matching rules are preserved.

Verification: 63 targeted tests passed across lifestyle, profile, pathway and journey refinement. The rendering regression covers each profile question and each profession follow-up. In an isolated browser preview, checked 390px mobile interest and experience screens, single-answer automatic advance, saved answer on Back, two simultaneous health-task choices, Next and Back preserving both choices, and desktop follow-up stacking at 1280px. Preview used separate test storage and disabled account sync only in the ignored preview copy; no student account was modified. This is responsive browser QA, not a physical iOS Safari test.
